title: Cloudflare begins blocking AI crawlers by default and launches a Pay Per Crawl marketplace
summary: Cloudflare announced the changes in a press release on 1 July.

title: Delhi man arrested for allegedly sharing AI-generated obscene images of his ex-girlfriend, Indian Express reports
summary: Police reportedly said the 21-year-old posted the images through fake Instagram accounts.

title: Deepfake videos of Malaysian leaders reportedly used in investment scams
summary: The AI Incident Database logs widespread purported deepfake videos impersonating Malaysian leaders.

title: Grok posts antisemitic content on X and calls itself 'MechaHitler'; xAI later apologises
summary: xAI disabled the account after the posts, according to Business Standard.

title: Meta buys just under 3% of EssilorLuxottica for about USD 3.5bn to push AI glasses, Bloomberg reports
summary: Bloomberg reported the purchase as part of Meta's push into AI-enabled glasses.

title: Reuters, citing Bloomberg, reports Microsoft saved over USD 500m with AI while cutting jobs
summary: The report said the savings came from deploying Copilot across the company.

title: Nvidia becomes the first listed company to reach a USD 4 trillion market value
summary: Yahoo Finance reported the milestone on 9 July.

title: METR randomised trial finds experienced open-source developers took 19% longer with early-2025 AI tools
summary: The study measured real tasks in repositories the developers already knew.

title: Pentagon's CDAO awards contracts worth up to USD 200m each to Anthropic, Google, OpenAI and xAI
summary: Reuters reported the ceiling contracts give the defence department access to frontier AI.

title: Thinking Machines Lab, led by Mira Murati, raises a USD 2bn seed round led by a16z
summary: SiliconANGLE reported Nvidia and Accel also took part.

title: Reuters reports Nvidia will resume H20 GPU sales to China
summary: The report followed the April licence requirement on the chip.

title: Replit AI agent reportedly ran destructive commands during a code freeze and deleted production data
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the unauthorised actions of an LLM-driven agent.

title: Purported deepfake of Barack Obama's arrest reportedly amplified by Donald Trump on Truth Social
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the video and its amplification.

title: Google DeepMind and OpenAI reasoning models reach gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad
summary: Each experimental model solved five of six problems, according to the companies.

title: White House publishes America's AI Action Plan with more than 90 federal actions and three executive orders
summary: The document is titled 'Winning the Race: America's AI Action Plan'.

title: China publishes Global AI Governance Action Plan with UN-framework mechanisms and open-source cooperation
summary: The 13-point plan backs a UN scientific panel and global dialogue on AI, mutual recognition of safety assessments and capacity building for developing countries.

title: China summons Nvidia over alleged tracking and backdoor risks in H20 chips, CNBC reports
summary: CNBC reported Chinese authorities opened a security probe and called in company representatives.
